problem.title: Task Batch Scheduler
problem.statement: You have a list of tasks with start and end times. Merge overlapping tasks into batches. Each batch can run several tasks simultaneously. Find the minimum number of batches needed.
problem.hint: Sort tasks by start time. If the next task starts before the previous one ends, they can be merged into one batch. If separated, start a new batch.
problem.walkthrough:
Example tasks: [[1, 4], [2, 3], [5, 7], [6, 8], [9, 10]].

Sorted: [1,4], [2,3], [5,7], [6,8], [9,10]

Take [1,4] as start of batch 1.
[2,3]: start 2 <= end 4? Yes! Merge.
[5,7]: start 5 <= end 4? No. New batch: [5,7].
[6,8]: start 6 <= end 7? Yes! Merge.
[9,10]: start 9 <= end 8? No. New batch: [9,10].

Answer: 3 batches.

Key insight: sort by start first, then merge overlapping ones.
